packageRules.description: Stateless services + digest pins: patch/minor/digest only, auto-merge after CI green + a 3-day soak so a bad upstream release doesn't land same-day. Rule order matters -- the stateful/critical rule below is listed last so it overrides this one for the specific packages it names.
CI tooling (GitHub Actions): low risk, easy to revert, auto-merge after soak.
Dev tooling (pre-commit hooks, Terraform providers): doesn't touch live services, auto-merge after soak.
Major updates, any package: always PR-only, one PR per package (not grouped -- each major is its own migration, shouldn't be bundled with an unrelated one).

Stateful/critical services -- databases, Vault, Authelia, Garage, Vaultwarden, and apps whose upgrades need a manual data migration (Nextcloud, Paperless, Immich, Gitea) or whose breakage takes out backups/auth cluster-wide (Velero's own restic/kopia plugin). ALL update types (patch/minor/major) stay PR-only, grouped into one PR per bump wave so they're one glance instead of scattered across the inbox. Listed last so it wins over the stateless auto-merge rule above for these specific packages. icereed/paperless-gpt added 2026-07-07 (REL-060) after v0.26.0 auto-merged and immediately CrashLoopBackOff'd -- its entrypoint isn't stable against this repo's readOnlyRootFilesystem hardening across versions, needs manual verification per bump.
